item.title: Boyle Co. dominates 4a state title game, 34-0
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC 36 NEWS NOW) – The Rebels are state champions, again. Boyle County shutout Franklin County 34-0 on Friday night, marking their fifth state title in six years and 13th in program history. The MVP of Friday night’s game was do-it-all senior Seneca Driver. item.title: Lexington Police investigate a bomb threat at a local Walmart
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) — A Walmart in Lexington was evacuated Saturday evening after police responded to a reported bomb threat, authorities said.
